version: LOCK 69 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the scholar's notebook, chapter 6: Worship
builds_on: LOCK 3 (page 1, read with Idris), LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 51 (the last page). Every reference checked on sunnah.com; the game never shows the reference.

chapter.title: Worship
chapter.story: He wrote that he learned more from one night of prayer in a caravanserai than from a year of books.

pages.saying: Whoever intends a good deed and doesn't do it, it is written as one good deed; if he does it, ten or more. Whoever intends a bad deed and doesn't do it, it is written as a good deed.
pages.idris: Even turning back from a wrong is written for you. Allah is generous.
pages.found: Abbas found a page lining an old hat bought from a pedlar.

pages.saying: Allah says: My servant draws near to Me with nothing more beloved than what I made obligatory, and keeps drawing near with extra deeds until I love him.
pages.idris: Pray the five first. Then add a little, and keep adding.
pages.found: Karim hands you a loaf wrapped in an old page. “Look at the writing on this.”

pages.saying: Allah has pardoned my people for mistakes, for forgetting, and for what they are forced into.
pages.idris: You will make mistakes. That's not the same as choosing wrong.
pages.found: The innkeeper found a folded page in a crack while mending a wall. “It's in a scholar's hand. You'll know who wants it.”

pages.saying: Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a traveller.
pages.idris: You came here as a traveller. Maybe that's why you see Ilmara so clearly.
pages.found: Children are flying a kite made from an old page. Yunus the muezzin buys it from them for a date and gives it to you.

pages.saying: None of you truly believes until his desires follow what I have brought.
pages.idris: Not the other way round. Let the guidance lead.
pages.found: Faris found a page pressed inside a second-hand book.

pages.saying: Allah says: O son of Adam, as long as you call on Me and hope in Me, I will forgive you; even if your sins reached the clouds and you asked forgiveness, I would forgive you.
pages.idris: Read this one twice. Then keep it for a hard night.
pages.found: Salma has been using a page to wrap spices and has only just noticed the writing.

pages.saying: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness, and gives for gentleness what He does not give for harshness.
pages.idris: Gentle with the donkey, gentle with the debtor, gentle with yourself.
pages.found: Rashid pulls a damp page from the bottom of a basket and dries it for you.

pages.saying: In a journey with no water, the verse of tayammum came down - and people said it was a blessing that came through the family of Abu Bakr.
pages.idris: Ghazi's palms on the stone. Allah made it easy for us.
pages.found: Layla found a page under a loose floor tile.

pages.saying: The Prophet went out to the prayer ground to ask for rain, faced the qibla, prayed two rak'ahs and turned his cloak inside out.
pages.idris: You stood on the dry ground with the whole town. You remember the rain.
pages.found: Jamal was given a debt note - and the scholar's page is written on the back of it.

pages.saying: The one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not are like the living and the dead.
pages.idris: Remember Allah walking to the market. It costs nothing and it's life.
pages.found: Abbas's little one folded a page into a paper boat. Abbas dried it out for you.
